references.title: UU 7/1983 as amended by UU 36/2008 art.4(1)(a): a payment or reward in connection with employment, in any form, is income; PMK 168/2023 art.5(1)(a) and (3): a pegawai’s regular or irregular income in any form is the PPh 21 object (PPh 26 for a non-resident). No art.4(3) exemption covers a cash compensation, so it is taxed as irregular income; it is not upah pokok or a tunjangan tetap, so outside the BPJS wage (PP 44/2015 art.19(2)). references.title: PP 35/2021 arts.15–17: a fixed-term worker who is not a foreign national (art.15(5): “tidak berlaku bagi tenaga kerja asing”, read on `employee.nationality`, not on tax residency) with at least one month of continuous service receives one month of basic wage plus fixed allowances per 12 months served, pro rata, including an early end. Article 16(6) replaces that schedule with the worker-employer agreement for a micro or small enterprise. PP 35/2021 art.15(2) pays the compensation when the PKWT ends, and PP 68/2009 art.1 angka 4 defines uang pesangon as income paid "dengan nama dan dalam bentuk apapun, sehubungan dengan berakhirnya masa kerja atau terjadi pemutusan hubungan kerja", so it carries the final PPh 21 severance rates (`PPH21_FINAL_SEVERANCE`) and leaves the TER base; a non-resident's is PPh 26. Kring Pajak (DJP, 7 June 2023) refers compensation paid in connection with the end of service to PP 68/2009 and PMK-16/PMK.03/2010. Art.15(4): when a PKWT is extended the compensation for the period before the extension is paid when that period ends (PKWT_TERM_END_COMPENSATION duty), and the extension’s when it ends: the band prices the months of the term in force (`terms.effective_from` to the exit or the term’s end), one month’s wage per 12 (art.16(1)): “masa kerja/12 × 1 (satu) bulan Upah”, the service counted in completed calendar months and the part month at ÷30 a calendar day (as PKWT_EARLY_TERMINATION), so a term ending part-way through a month is paid for those days.

references.title: PP 35/2021 arts.49–52 and 54: the listed causes carry separation pay only where and at the amount stated in the employment agreement, company regulation or collective agreement. PP 68/2009 art.1 angka 4 defines uang pesangon as income paid under whatever name and in whatever form in connection with the end of service or termination, so uang pisah carries the final PPh 21 severance rates (`PPH21_FINAL_SEVERANCE`) and is outside the TER base; a non-resident's is PPh 26.

references.title: PP 36/2021 art.61(1)–(2): an employer paying the wage late owes a fine counted from the day it was due (`entry.wage_due_on`, `wage_paid_on`, `wage_due_amount`): from the 4th to the 8th day 5% of the wage due for each day late; after the 8th day 1% more for each further day, the month’s fine at most 50%; after a month the highest state-bank interest rate on top (`entry.late_interest_amount`, computed by the employer at that rate). The wage itself stays due (art.61(2)); the fine is income received in connection with the work (PPh 21 additional). Days are counted from the due day as day 1 (“terhitung tanggal seharusnya Upah dibayarkan”, art.61(1)(a)): a wage paid three days after its due day is paid on the 4th day and carries 5%. The record takes this reading, the worker’s, of the counting the regulation leaves open.

references.title: UU 13/2003 art.62 (kept by UU 6/2023; https://jdih.kemnaker.go.id/peraturan/detail/27/undang-undang-nomor-13-tahun-2003): a party that ends a fixed-term agreement (PKWT) before its term, other than on the art.61(1) grounds (death, the term or the work ending, a court decision, an event the agreement names), pays the other party damages of the worker’s wage up to the end of the term. Priced here as the monthly wage (basic plus fixed allowances, `terms.monthly_wage`) for each whole month from the day after the exit to the term’s last day (`entry.term_end_date`, else the term’s own end `terms.effective_to`), and the part month at ÷30 a calendar day (the record’s reading). It is owed beside the PP 35/2021 art.15–17 compensation (PKWT_COMPENSATION). Paid by the employer when it ends the employment (exit ground DISMISSAL, REDUNDANCY, RETRENCHMENT or UNILATERAL); as income paid in connection with the end of the work it carries the PP 68/2009 final severance rates (PPH21_FINAL_SEVERANCE), a non-resident’s PPh 26.

references.title: UU 13/2003 art.62 (kept by UU 6/2023; https://jdih.kemnaker.go.id/peraturan/detail/27/undang-undang-nomor-13-tahun-2003): a party that ends a fixed-term agreement (PKWT) before its term, other than on the art.61(1) grounds (death, the term or the work ending, a court decision, an event the agreement names), pays the other party damages of the worker’s wage up to the end of the term. Priced here as the monthly wage (basic plus fixed allowances, `terms.monthly_wage`) for each whole month from the day after the exit to the term’s last day (`entry.term_end_date`, else the term’s own end `terms.effective_to`), and the part month at ÷30 a calendar day (the record’s reading). It is owed beside the PP 35/2021 art.15–17 compensation (PKWT_COMPENSATION). Owed by the worker who resigns before the term ends; recovered from the final pay as damages, within the PP 36/2021 art.65 50% deduction ceiling (WAGE_DEDUCTION_CEILING), the rest being a debt outside payroll.
